description: This file defines the LimitStream class, which is a decorator implementing the StreamInterface to read a subset of a stream with specified offset and limit. It provides methods for controlling and querying the limited reading of streaming data.

classes.name: LimitStream
classes.description: A decorator class that limits the amount of data read from an underlying stream, starting from a specific offset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LimitStream with a stream, optional limit, and offset.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the limited stream has been reached.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the subset of data within the limit and offset.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position within the limited stream.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position relative to the offset.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the starting offset from which data is read.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bytes that can be read.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream up to the limit.

search-terms: offset and limit of stream reading
